messages:
Alex W.: ok team — pulled a first pass at a tiny 'latency -> $ per 1k tokens' sparkline pack for the launch one-pager. link: https://drive.redwood/latency-dollar/spark-1.png
Priya: looking now. love the simple axis. can we make the cost axis 'estimated $ per 1k tokens' to avoid econ nitpicks?
Nate: one quick Q — are these using prefix cache assumptions? numbers look optimistic for short-turn chat.
Alex W.: good catch. this pass assumes 20% cache hit and batching=16. i can swap to a conservative slice (0% cache, batch=4) as a second column.
Jordan: design note — if we show two columns (conservative vs optimized) label them as "typical startup" and "production optimized"? keeps it human. also recommend colorblind-safe palette.
Priya: yes to two columns. for positioning, let's frame it as "what you pay now vs what you can tune to cut cost by X" — not just raw numbers. story should end with a clear call to action: "Discover how to cut your per-call cost" (CTA -> demo/signup).
Nate: for webinar slide deck, i'd suggest slide 2 be this visual, slide 3 show a short table with exact assumptions: batch, cache, quantization, model size. keeps claims transparent.
Alex W.: adding that. also dropping a tiny code snippet for the assumptions block so ops can reproduce: ```bash
# assumptions
BATCH=4
CACHE_HIT=0.2
MODEL=7b
```
Jordan: copy tweak — change "See how we cut" to "Discover how to cut" (so it's discovery, not promise).
MarketingBot: new doc version uploaded: https://drive.redwood/latency-dollar/spark-1_v2.png — includes conservative column + assumptions table.
Priya: quick inbound routing thought — can we make the CTA routes depend on org size? e.g., startups -> self-serve guide, enterprise -> contact AE. reduces friction.
Nate: agree. also propose we A/B test two CTAs in the landing post for 2 weeks. traffic split 50/50.
Alex W.: brilliant. Jordan, can you mock two CTA buttons? one for "Try a cost demo" and one for "Request an enterprise walkthrough".
Jordan: on it. will drop mocks by EOD.
Priya: webinar idea — run a 30-min session: "From latency to dollars: where teams bleed tokens". short demo + 10m Q&A + a live toggles walkthrough (batching/cache). schedule for two weeks after launch.
Alex W.: locking that. Nate — can you own the assumptions table and a lightweight reproducible notebook for the webinar?
Nate: yep, i'll assemble a Colab with runnable examples and attach it to the post.
Alex W.: thanks. final little ask: let's keep the social copy brief and provocative. draft: "Why speed can save you money. See how performance tuning slices inference costs. Register -> [webinar] / Try demo -> [guide]". feedback?
Priya: good. maybe add a short stat line above the fold: "Cut inference cost by up to 3x with simple runtime tuning (batching, cache)" — but flag as example rather than promise.
Jordan: approved on wording + visuals. i'll also export an HTML snapshot for marketing CMS.
Alex W.: great momentum. i'll post the first draft of the blog + assets tomorrow morning and tag you all for final signoff. :thumbsup:
